'''Gonzo yellow cheese sauce''' was a [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] made from [[Gonzo yellow cheese]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]][[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] sold a lunch side of  of [[pashi noodles]] in Gonzo yellow cheese sauce for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gonzo yellow cheese saucewas mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
